title: Detailed pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pencil body - yellow -->
  <rect x='38' y='20' width='14' height='50' rx='2' fill='#F5C842'/>
  <!-- Pencil body highlight -->
  <rect x='38' y='20' width='5' height='50' rx='2' fill='#FADF7A'/>
  <!-- Pencil body shadow strip -->
  <rect x='48' y='20' width='4' height='50' rx='1' fill='#D4A820'/>
  <!-- Wood cone -->
  <polygon points='38,70 52,70 45,88' fill='#E8C48A'/>
  <!-- Wood cone lighter side -->
  <polygon points='38,70 45,70 45,88' fill='#F2DBAE'/>
  <!-- Wood cone shadow -->
  <polygon points='45,70 52,70 45,88' fill='#D4A865'/>
  <!-- Graphite tip -->
  <polygon points='43,82 47,82 45,90' fill='#7A7A8C'/>
  <!-- Graphite tip highlight -->
  <polygon points='43,82 45,82 45,90' fill='#9E9EB0'/>
  <!-- Metal ferrule -->
  <rect x='37' y='14' width='16' height='16' rx='1' fill='#C0C0D0'/>
  <!-- Ferrule ridges -->
  <rect x='37' y='17' width='16' height='2' fill='#D8D8E8'/>
  <rect x='37' y='21' width='16' height='2' fill='#D8D8E8'/>
  <rect x='37' y='25' width='16' height='2' fill='#D8D8E8'/>
  <!-- Ferrule highlight -->
  <rect x='37' y='14' width='4' height='16' rx='1' fill='#E0E0F0'/>
  <!-- Eraser -->
  <rect x='37' y='6' width='16' height='8' rx='3' fill='#F08090'/>
  <!-- Eraser highlight -->
  <rect x='37' y='6' width='5' height='8' rx='3' fill='#F8A8B4'/>
  <!-- Eraser shadow -->
  <rect x='48' y='6' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#D06070'/>
  <!-- Pencil wood grain lines -->
  <line x1='41' y1='70' x2='45' y2='86' stroke='#D4A865' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='70' x2='45' y2='86' stroke='#C09850' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <line x1='47' y1='70' x2='45' y2='86' stroke='#D4A865' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Subtle face on pencil - cute eyes on body -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='2' fill='#3A3A4A'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='38' r='2' fill='#3A3A4A'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='43.7' cy='37.3' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='47.7' cy='37.3' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Cute smile -->
  <path d='M43 43 Q45 46 47 43' stroke='#3A3A4A' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='42' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#F08090' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#F08090' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
